title: GRACE key/radius memory with Mirror-compressed values
hypothesis: Holding GRACE keys and per-key deferral radii fixed, one shared value basis plus a continuous Mirror angle per edit will preserve memory hits and output quality while reducing actual serialized bytes versus explicit GRACE values and fixed-size value codebooks; a generic shared-basis coefficient code tests whether the gain is Mirror-specific.
physical_object: GRACE key/radius memory plus one shared 16D value basis
mirror_coordinate: continuous per-entry value angle; key and radius state remain fully explicit
logical_multiplicity: 64 retained edit values selected by the unchanged GRACE memory key
controls: generic Cartesian coefficients on the same value basis
uniform K=8,16,32,64 value codebooks with per-entry indices

task.key_and_radius: random unit keys plus explicitly stored per-key radius 0.87-0.93; same for all methods
task.value_orbit: fixed-norm 1.2 values on one known 2D plane
task.queries: exact keys; four Gaussian-noise paraphrases sigma .03 per key; 256 unrelated random queries
metrics: reconstructed value NRMSE and retention vs edit count
false-trigger rate and unrelated output drift
measured lookup plus selected-value decode latency

development.allowed: fixed radius distribution and predetermined K codebook sweep; no fresh-dependent selection

paid_objects: all GRACE keys and per-key radii
explicit values or shared basis plus Mirror/generic coordinates
all VQ codebook values and per-entry indices

success_gate: Every fresh world at N64: exact/paraphrase hit recall >=99%, unrelated false triggers <=1%, continuous Mirror value NRMSE <=1e-5, and payload <=80% explicit GRACE. Compare K-codebook and generic shared-basis Pareto frontiers; no Mirror-specific gain if a simpler control matches at equal/fewer bytes.
failure_gate: Continuous Mirror misses quality/retrieval/byte gates, or a fixed codebook/generic control matches or beats its bytes at equal quality; preserve N-dependent results.
boundaries: Synthetic GRACE-style key/value mechanism screen, not a GRACE or model-editing reproduction.
Value basis and orbit are known by construction. Retrieval key/radius state is unchanged and fully charged.
No sequential lifelong update training; N sweeps measure stored-bank growth only.
